negative_evidence_policy: A bounded no-match records only the searched surface and terms. A rate limit, authentication response, timeout, or security checkpoint is an access failure and never negative evidence.
append_only_policy: A concrete candidate observed after the cutoff creates a successor inventory. It is not folded into version 1 to preserve a favorable classification.
